_schema.purpose: MCS-31 enforcement record. Populated only by `guide_confirm.py --audit --write`, never by hand. score_submission.py reads this file at the start of every scoring run and refuses to auto-score a listed criterion — it emits level:null, confidence:GUIDE_ONLY instead of a guess.
_schema.demoted: criterion -> {rate, n, overrides, demoted_on}. Presence in this dict IS the demotion. Removing a key un-demotes it (e.g. after the detector is fixed) — do that by hand, deliberately, with a DECISIONS.md row.
